name: 깃발 아치길
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: Wide processional corridor with four heraldic banners hanging beneath a row of stone arches, their colors reflected faintly in polished patterned floor tiles below. Warm amber torchlight glows along the arch bases while cool teal moonlight slants through a distant window at the corridor's end. Open lower-central foreground, richly detailed banner fabric, deep architectural perspective and a long vanishing point, no people, no text, no UI.
